item.description:
Aside 1.6.2

The speech model now repairs itself. If you ever saw "The speech model failed to load" on every launch, this release is for you.

Fixed

  • A broken speech model heals itself. If a model download was interrupted (crash, power loss, flaky Wi-Fi), Aside could get permanently stuck refusing to record. It now detects the broken files, clears them, and fetches a fresh copy automatically — recording works again within seconds.
  • Speaker detection heals the same way. A damaged speaker-recognition cache no longer silently disables speaker labels forever; it is cleared and re-downloaded once.
  • Your license can't be lost to a damaged file. A corrupted license file is set aside for recovery instead of being silently overwritten.
  • Crash recovery keeps its screenshots. Housekeeping can no longer clean up a recovered meeting's images while its note is still being written.
